name: Athame Artis
effectTemplate:
CRIT DMG from Elemental Bursts is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color>. When an Elemental Burst hits an opponent, gain the Blade of the Daylight Hours effect: ATK is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color>. Nearby active party members other than the equipping character have their ATK increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{2}</color> for 3s.
Additionally, when the party possesses Hexerei: Secret Rite effects, the effects of Blade of the Daylight Hours are increased by an additional 75%. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
